decisions.reason: Its move from a general mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 suggests increasing commitment and revealed demand, while as a close-fit sensor module it is inexpensive to keep as part of the platform.
This module has dedicated presentation across both years and fits the firm's industrial modular architecture closely, so the option now looks valuable enough to retain and build on.

Although evidence of traction is weaker than for A or B, it is a close complement to the established automation range and likely cheap to keep on the market while uncertainty about demand resolves further.
As a 2024 launch in an adjacent application area, it is still too early to judge fully and the firm's broad modular portfolio makes it sensible to preserve this low-cost option for another period.

Remote access for wallboxes supports the firm's stated expansion in charging and energy management, and despite some ongoing service cost the product is strategically important enough that the option should remain open in 2025.
